news.contents: Indianapolis quarterback Daniel Jones has not had a very good season, but he could be in for one of his better fantasy showings against Miami in Week 10. The Dolphins are a favorable matchup, and this is one of the few winnable games the Colts have remaining, so Jones' outlook is pretty solid. He has completed just 60.3% of his passes for 1,722 yards and six touchdowns, while being intercepted 10 times. Jones has 86 rushing yards and a score on 28 attempts as well. news.contents: The Minnesota Vikings' acquisition of veteran quarterback Kirk Cousins should elevate the team's struggling offense, which could mean additional chances for running back Aaron Jones Sr. in Week 10 at Green Bay. The former Packer has just 64 rushing yards in the past three games, but Minnesota's offense has been so helpless that it's hard to fault the team's running backs for the team's inability to stay on the field. news.contents: Seattle Seahawks running back Jadarian Price could be a low-end flex play in Week 10 against the Las Vegas Raiders. Price is clearly running behind Zach Charbonnet in Seattle's backfield. However, he is the more explosive back. Price only received nine carries to Charbonnet's 16 in Week 9, but Price also turned four targets into four receptions for 54 yards. Additionally, Price's snap share fell to 36% in Week 9. news.contents: New Orleans Saints running back Alvin Kamara rushed just six times for 32 yards and added three catches for another 17 yards in Week 9's victory over the Browns. Kamara out-snapped fellow running back Audric Estime 37-35, though it was Estime who out-gained him 77-49 in total yards. Kamara's inefficient season continues, as he is averaging just 3.3 yards per carry on 6.7 attempts per game, both career lows. The 25-year-old has cooled off considerably since a surge over Weeks 6 and 7 when he totaled 200 yards and three touchdowns, hauling in four catches for 55 yards over Weeks 8 and 9. news.analysis: As expected, Kelce was able to practice all week and will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Falcons. He will continue to be a safe PPR option on a week-to-week basis, though his ceiling isn't all that high at this point in his career.

news.title: Travis Kelce (ankle) good to go for Sunday

news.contents: Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce has been one of the most reliable offensive weapons in the team's passing attack this season and he should continue to be this weekend against the Atlanta Falcons. Kelce was listed on the Chiefs' injury report this week as he's still tending to his ankle injury, but he practiced fully all week and does not have a designation ahead of the game. news.contents: The Los Angeles Rams have "optimism" that wide receiver Davante Adams (hamstring) will return for the team's Week 12 contest against the Green Bay Packers, according to Ian Rapoport of NFL Network. Adams injured his hamstring in Week 6, underwent surgery, and was given a 6-to-12-week timeline for his recovery.
